gate.paired_wall_ratio_definition: Align the 18 main task-and-round identities. For each pair divide the larger full API wait by the smaller; then take the median of the 18 ratios. This treats faster and slower differences symmetrically. Both completion and basic-task requirements must also pass.
gate.overall_recommendation: Compare completed work first, then full waiting time, generated-token consumption and actual allocation. Keep task-specific failures visible; state the recommendation only for tested hardware, settings and work.
